text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well, I've graced you with my presence...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
At dusk, a magical power that grants 
mysterious strength and provides a huge 
power boost—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Goddess Statue!! I challenge you to a 
magic duel!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll use a "Magic Reflect" to make your 
magic useless... Now, let's see if you can 
break my magic!
